items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Yes, my father knew all the Tio's. He knew all of them.

ctx.x: There's another one. Every now and then something comes back.
Did he ever mention the Tio's? Yes, Lorenzo Tio. And then there were two older, Papa Tio and Lorenzo Senior, I think they called him.
Yes, my father knew all the Tio's. He knew all of them. They were very friendly with each other.
